title: Postman API key: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 33-byte second segment vs the 34 gitleaks corroborates (58-byte body vs the 59 both pinned tools corroborate). Twin of "Postman API key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
